title: Britannin inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma development and metastasis through the GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Lu, Qinwei; Zhu, Junlin; Teng, Linxin; Chen, Cuihua; Bi, Lei; Chen, Weiping
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 研究Britannin通过GSK-3beta/beta-catenin通路抑制肝癌，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) stands out as a significant contributor to cancer-related death. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) offers several advantages in the treatment of HCC. Britannin, a pivotal compound in Inulae Flos, has demonstrated pharmacological effects against various cancers, yet research on its specific anti-HCC effects remains limited. PURPOSE: This study aims to explore the anti-HCC effects of britannin and its underlying mechanism. METHODS: MTT assay, clone formation assay and flow cytometry were utilized to detect the cell activity, proliferation ability and apoptosis of britannin against HCC cell lines. Cell migration and invasion abilities of HCC cell lines treated with britannin were evaluated by wound-healing assay and transwell migration and invasion assay. H22 xenografted tumor mouse model was constructed and britannin treatment was performed to observe the effect of britannin on HCC tumors. The expression levels of liver cancer biomarkers AFP, AFP-L3, APT and TGF-beta were detected by Elisa, and the histopathology was observed by HE staining. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict the possible signaling pathway of anti-HCC effect of britannin. The surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiment was used to verify the interaction between britannin and proteins. The cell kinase activity function experiment was employed to detect the effect of britannin on enzyme activity. RT-qPCR and Western-Blot were used to verify the effect of britannin on the mRNA expressions of key genes and protein levels related to GSK-3beta/beta-catenin pathway in HCC cells and tumor tissues in mice. RESULTS: In vitro experiments showed that britannin could inhibit the activity, proliferation, migration and invasion abilities of HCC cells, while promoting their apoptosis. In vivo experiments revealed that britannin exerted inhibitory effects on the growth of transplanted liver cancer tumors, reducing the inflammatory infiltration and the expression levels of AFP, AFP-L3, APT and TGF-beta of liver cancer markers in transplanted mice. Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted that cell adhesion factors and GSK-3beta/beta-catenin pathway might be the related signaling pathway and had potential docking activity with key proteins. The SPR experiments elucidated the molecular interaction between britannin and GSK-3beta. Enzyme activity assays indicated that britannin could modulate the functional activity of GSK-3beta kinase. RT-qPCR suggested britannin could regulate the mRNA expressions of beta-catenin, GSK-3beta, E-cadherin and NCadherin. Western-Blot further verified that britannin could significantly up-regulate the expression of GSK-3beta and down-regulate the expression of p-GSK-3beta and beta-catenin. At the same time, the expression of E-cadherin increased and NCadherin decreased, thereby reducing the occurrence of EMT and inhibiting the metastasis of HCC. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, britannin could inhibit the growth, development and metastasis of HCC, and its mechanism may be related to the regulation of GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway to inhibit epithelial-mesenchymal transition of HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是癌症相关死亡的重要诱因。传统中药（TCM）在治疗HCC方面具有多种优势。Britannin作为旋覆花中的关键化合物，已显示出对多种癌症的药理作用，但其对HCC的特异性抗肿瘤作用研究仍有限。目的：本研究旨在探讨britannin的抗HCC作用及其潜在机制。方法：采用MTT实验、克隆形成实验和流式细胞术检测britannin对HCC细胞系的细胞活性、增殖能力和凋亡的影响。通过划痕愈合实验和transwell迁移及侵袭实验评估britannin处理的HCC细胞系的迁移和侵袭能力。构建H22异种移植瘤小鼠模型并进行britannin治疗，观察其对HCC肿瘤的作用。通过Elisa检测肝癌生物标志物AFP、AFP-L3、APT和TGF-beta的表达水平，并通过HE染色观察组织病理学。利用网络药理学和分子对接预测britannin抗HCC作用的可能信号通路。采用表面等离子共振（SPR）实验验证britannin与蛋白质之间的相互作用。通过细胞激酶活性功能实验检测britannin对酶活性的影响。使用RT-qPCR和Western-Blot验证britannin对HCC细胞和小鼠肿瘤组织中GSK-3beta/beta-catenin通路相关关键基因mRNA表达和蛋白水平的影响。结果：体外实验表明，britannin能抑制HCC细胞的活性、增殖、迁移和侵袭能力，同时促进其凋亡。体内实验显示，britannin对移植性肝癌肿瘤的生长具有抑制作用，减少移植小鼠中炎症浸润及肝癌标志物AFP、AFP-L3、APT和TGF-beta的表达水平。网络药理学和分子对接预测细胞粘附因子和GSK-3beta/beta-catenin通路可能是相关信号通路，并具有与关键蛋白的潜在对接活性。SPR实验阐明了britannin与GSK-3beta之间的分子相互作用。酶活性实验表明，britannin能调节GSK-3beta激酶的功能活性。RT-qPCR提示britannin能调节beta-catenin、GSK-3beta、E-cadherin和N-cadherin的mRNA表达。Western-Blot进一步验证，britannin能显著上调GSK-3beta的表达并下调p-GSK-3beta和beta-catenin的表达。同时，E-cadherin表达增加而N-cadherin减少，从而减少上皮-间质转化（EMT）的发生并抑制HCC的转移。结论：总之，britannin能抑制HCC的生长、发展和转移，其机制可能与调节GSK-3beta/beta-catenin信号通路以抑制HCC的上皮-间质转化有关。
